name: labs/mabuchilab__instrumental
title: Thorlabs DCx (UC480) camera (Instrumental UC480_Camera)
intro: Thorlabs DCx (UC480) camera (Instrumental UC480_Camera), adapted from mabuchilab/instrumental. It reads `trigger_mode`, `trigger_level`, `auto_gain`, `auto_framerate` and 9 more; sets `trigger_delay`, `exposure_time`, `gamma` and `auto_exposure`; runs `configure_trigger`, `capture`, `start_live_video`, `stop_live_video` and 1 more. `configure_trigger`: set the camera trigger mode and, for hardware triggering, the edge. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
